response.overview: It wasn't a triumphant reassertion of their place in the rock pantheon, but it also wasn't an unnecessary nostalgia trip when British rock legends the Who returned to the Valley for the first time in over 10 years on Wednesday.  The band has staged several reunion tours since its 1982 "breakup" almost to the point of parody. Perhaps that's why US Airways Center was only half full.  The circumstances were quite different this time, however. Founding members singer Roger Daltrey and guitarist Pete Townshend looked re-energized, even though they were touring without bassist John Entwistle, who died in 2002. And for the first time in over 20 years the band had new material to showcase, from its 2006 CD Endless Wire.
response.title: The Who: Phoenix 2/28/2007
